content: Further, we have conducted an additional experiment on this dataset by progressively reducing the training data for all the compared systems. The BERT-based model shows the highest robustness to training-data scarcity, loosing only 7 points of F1-score when trained on 230 instances instead of 21,371. These observation are in line with the results obtained by the NLP community using BERT for other tasks.
